title: Bix's mother, sister and cornet
summary: Talk of Bix's mother's death, his sister in Lexington, and one of his cornets in the New Orleans Jazz Museum.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Can you think of anything else? That goes Bix's... I don't know whether Bix's mother's still living or not.
No, she died. Did she? Because when I was in Danforth, she died about five years ago.
Oh, I didn't know that. His sister, I think, was here several years ago, or a cousin or something. But, uh... Yeah. I don't know too much about her. Yeah. His sister is living in Lexington, Mass.

Is she? Yeah. And I think she has possession of one of his horns, you know, his cornets. One of his cornets is down in the Jazz Museum in New Orleans. I guess it was one he played with Ben Pollack for a short time, when he was playing with Ben Pollack.
I didn't know he ever played with Ben Pollack. I don't either, but...
I don't think he did ever play with Ben Pollack. Yeah. But, uh...
